description: The bicubic dome generated by tools/oracle/occt_bicubic_dome.py. Each symmetric control row and column rises towards its middle, so the maximum is at (u, v) = (1/2, 1/2). The nonzero cubic basis weights there are (1/4, 1/2, 1/4) in each direction and give height 17/4. The planar square base gives the other five sides.
